g.text: other families (each in < 10% of the group's loci)
no id at level pfam (never shared)
nbr flanks: group all, 28 loci in 28 leaves (28 in the tree, 28 context types)
release rN.3, level pfam, window 10g, distance j, cut 0.5; a family's colour is the same in every group of the run; % = share of the group's loci holding it
rows: all 28 leaves in the tree, in tree order; each row draws its leaf's first locus (least feature_uid); loci = the loci collapsed into the leaf
